title: Scald wreck shadowData fix + ambient water-agitation ripple mechanism (margin calm / shallow light / deep heavy)
ownerSaid: What do you want me to say about (2)? Yes, they look a bit odd. Are you saying you can fix that? If so yes, you should to better match the sprite that's generating it. There is a difference in the margin vs shallow, though it's faint. Anything else we could do to make the boiling Scald water look a little more... boiling? Perhaps some rippling animation from bubles emerging from the surface? I notice that when people walk through the water they emit little ripples of disturbance, so perhaps we could just trigger those all over with a little bubble animation? Or just the disturbances themselves would be welcome to show how agitated the water is. That could be used to distinguish margin vs shallow vs deep as well: margin is calm, shallow has a bit of agitation, and deep has constant agitation.

title: Deepfire: new RM mod LuminousPigment — expensive glowing pigment (colour from the dye it's mixed with, pigment supplies a dim glow); +1 quality on art items / +beauty on others; paints walls/floors/furniture; extra coats only brighten; personal items light the pawn but make them easier to target in the dark; harvested from rare ocean bacterial mats (Utinni: the Scald); GlowTank grows it slowly; fresh mat decays very fast until refined; RimCuisine uses; god reactions; status via the purple engine; all Mod Settings
ownerSaid: It's its own RimMandrake mod: LuminousPigment. Required by the Scald mod.

text: Rulings 2026-09-25 (his message, typed): name Deepfire; mod LuminousPigment (RimMandrake tier), required by the Scald mod; colour from the normal dye object, pigment supplies glow; +1 quality on artistic items once, +beauty on other items; extra uses only brighten; walls/floors/furniture paintable (expensive); personal objects -> light sphere around the pawn + easier to target in darkness; night visibility = normal lights; harvest from rare ocean bacterial mats (Utinni places them in the Scald); GlowTank: hydroponics-like, seeded with fresh mat + ocean water if FlowWorks present, very low yield, moderate power/resources/space; fresh mat decays VERY fast until refined; RimCuisine uses with permanent positive/negative results; gods: hider dislikes, sellers/crafters adore, all but the hider love it on their statues; curing DROPPED; lacquered apparel/furniture = status via the same engine as Tyrian purple; everything Mod-Settings configurable; integrate with vanilla dye menus + Character Editor + Dubs Paint Shop if possible, else a separate paint tool.
ownerSaid: Curing sounds good but I'm not sure how to achieve that since it can be used on so many item types, so best to drop it.
